newsitem.title: FRANCE: CLF-Dexia France sees 1997 profit rise.
newsitem.headline: CLF-Dexia France sees 1997 profit rise.

text.p: French bank CLF Dexia-France, formed out of the merger of Credit Local de France and Belgium's Credit Communal, sees profit growth and higher dividends in 1997, chairman Pierre Richard told the Journal des Finances weekly.
He said in an interview that 1997 would be a "very good year" after the flat profits of 1995 and that there would be a return to the kind of nine percent profit growth seen between 1991 and 1994.
He said that the company was paying 34 percent of profits in dividends.
"Taking account of the expected profit rise in 1996, it is possible that the 1997 distributed dividend will be higher," he said.
Richard said that the bank's profit margins had stabilised and had increased in France after two years of falls.
